svg.text: Enough information to sell the offer without turning validation into a branding project.

g.text: LEAD-GENERATION WEBSITE SYSTEM
HEADLINE
A focused lead-generation website for established home-service companies
whose current site no longer reflects the business they have built.
THE PROBLEM
Prospects arrive from search, referrals, ads, or your Google Business Profile and still have to
work to understand what you do, whether you serve their area, why they should trust you,
and how to request an estimate.
THE OUTCOME
A modern, maintainable marketing site organized around services, trust, local relevance,
and clear inquiry paths — with analytics and a defined handoff.
INCLUDED
Discovery · defined page architecture · responsive implementation · inquiry forms · analytics
technical foundations · accessibility/performance QA · launch · handoff
NOT FOR
Ecommerce · customer portals · undefined web applications · complex migrations
open-ended integrations inside the base engagement
PROCESS
Qualify → kickoff → plan → build → review / QA → launch / handoff
NEXT STEP · Book a fit call to confirm whether the standard engagement matches.
Improve the copy after market feedback, not before you have any.
